ET1.description_en: The study population/domain does not match the target population specified in the protocol.

ET2.description_en: The study does not investigate or focus on the specified intervention/technology, or only mentions it in passing.

ET3.label_vi: Loại xuất bản ngoài phạm vi
ET3.description_en: The study is an editorial, poster, thesis, workshop summary, or non-peer-reviewed publication.

ET4.description_en: The study is not published in any of the allowed languages (e.g. English).

ET5.label_vi: Ngoài phạm vi năm công bố
ET5.description_en: The publication year of the study falls outside the range specified in the protocol.

ET6.description_en: The paper is a semantic duplicate or an older version of an already included study.

ET7.description_en: The study type (e.g., primary study vs secondary study) does not match the protocol requirements.

EF1.label_vi: Không có đánh giá thực nghiệm
EF1.description_en: no empirical evaluation while protocol requires measurable outcome

EF2.description_en: experiments exist but the protocol outcome is not measured/reported

EF3.description_en: The full text of the article could not be retrieved.

EF4.description_en: same authors + same experiments already in the included set
